in_marathi.name: Kulwant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kulwant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kulwant is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘kul’ meaning ‘desire’ and ‘want’ meaning ‘longing’. It represents a deep yearning or craving for something, often of spiritual or material nature.
